text.card: A star about 29 parsecs away, 1.6 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.6 solar radii and 1.48 solar masses (FLAME) and 7,094 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: 8 Draconis
quotes.card: 8 Draconis, formally named Taiyi, is a single star in the northern circumpolar constellation of Draco.
quotes.introduction: Based upon an annual parallax shift of 33.97 mas as seen from the Earth, the star is located 96 light-years from the Sun.
